decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already scopes USDC minting to the active replacement contract, with no obsolete attributes requiring removal.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already scopes future Transak mints to the active replacement contract, including while the requirement remains deferred.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits dashboard rendering to replacement-contract NFTs and excludes legacy-contract NFTs from the dashboard.
The existing message-539 MODIFY, supported by message 538, already restricts active-system NFT discovery to the replacement contract.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already excludes old-contract NFTs from active ownership and mint reporting.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already records the replacement-contract token sequence and excludes legacy NFT referral identities from the active system.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits active-system metadata use to replacement-contract NFTs without asserting that legacy on-chain metadata ceases to exist.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already excludes legacy-contract NFT transfer state, transfers, and transfer-linked benefits from the active system.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts platform statistics to replacement-contract activity and records that the replacement contract starts with fresh draw state.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits active-system NFT-gated book access to replacement-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already excludes legacy-contract referral, ticket, and payout data from active reporting.
Replacing the mint contract and excluding old NFTs does not change which payment options checkout exposes or how settlement currencies are selected and disclosed.
